_note: SAMPLE registry authored by the Pineapple build-brief pipeline (BUILD-20261117-006) from PINEAPPLE_NETWORK_OS_ARCHITECTURE.md section 2 (least-privilege roles). No real users; the first-run kit seeds SAMPLE accounts only.

ADMIN.description: Manage assigned users/modules; no Owner-private data unless granted.

FAMILY_USER.description: Own workspace, assigned tools, request analysis; cannot see others, cannot change settings.

OWNER.description: God Mode: all users, data, modules, logs, configs; create/revoke users, change permissions, export all, raw FS.

PAID_USER.description: Paid modules only; no family tools, no local files, no raw memory, no other users' data.

TRADER_USER.description: Watchlists, daily market reports, instrument analysis, trade notes; isolated.
